title: Translation Patch
description: A list of line-level translation changes proposed by an agent or human. Patches are reviewed and applied line-by-line; they never auto-overwrite the final translation file.

jobId.description: Originating agent job id, when known.

lineId.description: Global 1-based line number; must correspond to an existing source line.

oldText.description: Current translation text the patch expects to replace. Required for conflict detection against the live working state.

baseRevision.description: Revision the patch was generated against. Optional in the MVP; when set, mismatch with the current revision surfaces a conflict.

reason.description: Why the change is proposed (e.g. 术语统一, 漏译补全).

sourceFindingId.description: Link back to the proofread finding that produced this change, if any.
